caption: The drawing features a small ceramic pitcher positioned in the center of the composition, shown on a plain, cream-colored background delimited by a light rectangular border. The pitcher is predominantly white or light beige, with a round body, a short neck, and a flared lip. The handle is thick, rounded, and colored deep green. The main body of the pitcher is decorated with floral patterns; these patterns include red and pink flowers, green leaves, and some yellowish-brown foliage, arranged on the front and side surfaces. The floral decoration appears hand-painted, with visible brushstrokes and soft color transitions. At the bottom left of the border, the text "ACTUAL SIZE" is written in a rectangular box. In the lower right corner within the border, there is a signature reading "T. A. Holloway." There are no other objects or decorations present in the image.
title: Cream Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
